result.summary: The page is visually clean and well-structured overall. There is one minor layout issue where the last restaurant card is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, indicating the content is not fully scrollable or the bottom padding is insufficient.

issues.description: The last visible restaurant card (pizza image) is cut off at the bottom edge of the screen, making it appear incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or margin to the scrollable content area so that the last card is fully visible before the bottom navigation bar.
